payout_quote: To qualify for the $300 bonus, you must: (1) open a new Credit Union of the Rockies checking account; (2) establish and receive a qualifying direct deposit of at least $500 into the new checking account; and (3) maintain the checking account in good standing for at least 90 days after account opening. (4) Complete a minimum of five (5) transactions using your CUR Visa debit card within the first 90 days of account opening.
steps: Qualify for Credit Union of the Rockies membership (live or work in Clear Creek, Eagle, Gilpin, Grand, Jefferson, or Summit County, CO) and open a new checking account at https://www.cu-rockies.org/Membership/Membership.aspx.
Establish a qualifying direct deposit of at least $500 per month into the new checking account.

Complete at least 5 transactions with your CUR Visa debit card within the first 90 days and keep the account open and in good standing for 90 days; the $300 bonus is deposited after all requirements are met.
catches: New Credit Union of the Rockies members age 18+ only; membership eligibility required (live/work in Clear Creek, Eagle, Gilpin, Grand, Jefferson, or Summit County, CO; family and community-partner employees also eligible).
$500+ qualifying direct deposit per month, minimum 5 CUR Visa debit card transactions within the first 90 days, account kept open and in good standing for 90 days.
Limit one bonus per individual; cannot be combined with any other promotional offer.
$300 deposited after all requirements are met; bonus may be reported to the IRS (taxable).
Limited-time offer; may be modified or withdrawn at any time; accounts subject to approval.
biggest_catch: New members only, and you must live or work in one of six Colorado counties (Clear Creek, Eagle, Gilpin, Grand, Jefferson, Summit) — plus a $500/month direct deposit, 5 debit transactions, and keeping the account open 90 days.
eligibility: New Credit Union of the Rockies members age 18+; must qualify for membership (live/work in Clear Creek, Eagle, Gilpin, Grand, Jefferson, or Summit County CO, or family/community-partner eligibility); one bonus per individual.
timing: $300 bonus deposited into the qualifying checking account after all requirements have been met.
